objectives.statement: Recognize the fixed comparative correlative pattern jo + comparative, desto or jo + comparative.
Place the subject and finite verb correctly in both halves of a jo ... desto sentence.
Avoid English-like transfer such as the more ... the more in Norwegian.
Build natural Bokmål sentences that express proportional change with jo ... desto or jo ... jo.

notes: Must teach fixed comparative correlative pattern jo + comparative, desto/jo + comparative. Include word order and warn against English-like the more...the more transfer.
